label: Recovery & Wellness Studios
heroHeading: The whole circuit from one manufacturer
seoDescription: Recovery equipment & intelligent software for wellness studios. Boost retention with HBOT, red light, infrared sauna & cold therapy.

valueProps.title: Built around throughput
valueProps.body: A sauna for four to eight and a cold room for the same group keeps a contrast circuit moving on the hour, with nothing to drain or refill between groups.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Commercial duty cycles, all day, every day. Dry cold means no water chemistry, and infrared cabins are ready between groups.

valueProps.title: Protocols your staff can follow
valueProps.body: Doctor-built session protocols in the app, so a first-timer and a regular get the same guidance whoever is on shift.

features.title: Design the circuit, not just the kit
features.body: We lay out heat, cold and light so guests move through in a sequence that works, and so your busiest hour isn’t held up by one room.

features.title: Hyperbaric as the high-value session
features.body: Chambers run longer and need a trained operator, so they sit apart from the circuit and are booked on their own. We’ll tell you whether that’s worth it for your studio before you buy one.
